title: Day and Trial Passes: group class access, locker, towel rental, pool, and sauna access
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: whether standard group fitness classes are included, whether a day-use locker is included at no extra charge, the refundable deposit for the included locker, the fee to rent a towel, and whether pool and sauna access are included where the club has them.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Group classes included | Locker included | Locker deposit (USD) | Towel rental fee (USD) | Pool access included | Sauna access included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | No | No | 5.00 | 3.00 | No | No |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | Yes | No | 5.00 | 3.00 | Yes | No |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | Yes | Yes | 5.00 | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | Yes | Yes | 5.00 | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Monthly Trial Pass | Yes | Yes | 10.00 | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Corporate Guest Pass | No | No | 5.00 | 3.00 | No | No |

Where locker access is included, no extra charge is made for the locker itself, but the locker deposit is a refundable deposit recorded for the included locker. A towel rental fee of 0.00, as recorded for the Seven-Day Trial Pass, the Weekly Visitor Pass and the Monthly Trial Pass, means no charge is made for towel use on that tier. Pool and sauna access, where included, apply only at a club that has that amenity.
